title: People Search Bench — open eval for AI people-search agents
summary: MIT Python benchmark with 119 multilingual people-search queries scored on live web evidence (not LLM-as-judge). Reports relevance, coverage, and utility for Lessie, Exa, Claude Code, and Juicebox.
question_it_answers: How do you evaluate AI people-search agents with reproducible, web-verified scoring?

claims.text: Lessie leads the published overall score at 65.2 versus Exa 55.0 and Claude Code 46.0.
claims.subject: outbound-gtm-agents

claims.text: Scoring uses Tavily web search verification with Cohen's kappa 0.84 against human annotators.
claims.evidence: Verification uses live web search (Tavily API), not LLM-as-judge. Cohen's kappa = 0.84 with human annotators (per arXiv abstract).
